name: sancho-fetch
description: Ask Claude for public data; Sancho fetches it into real files on your computer.
long_description: Installs an exact Sancho Fetch runtime through Claude Desktop's managed uv support. Data is stored in a stable folder outside the extension bundle and is preserved when the extension is removed. The first launch downloads the pinned Python package and its dependencies.

workspace.title: Sancho data folder
workspace.description: Stable folder outside the extension bundle where Sancho keeps fetched data, custom modules, playbooks, outputs, logs, and private API-key settings.
